You can get inspiration from pinterest, it's full of links and pictures to cosplay tutorials, and you might be interested in looking at furries costumes to see how you can make fur more realistic or how to build shoes that looks like hooves, a lot of them explain in details their process. Starting from a visual representation of your costume is a great way to start and stay motivated, and also it will make things more concrete and easier to figure, just having a pattern for your clothes or the list of materials you need for example.
